brief: A tool rack that hangs on a wall from keyhole hangers, with hooks for small hand tools.

requirements.requirement: Tool rack that hangs on a wall from keyhole hangers
requirements.evidence: Two hex-acc-keyhole accessories fitted on the outer end cells of a 3-wide row: accessory:0#-1,0#1 and accessory:0#1,0#2, spaced across the rack so wall screws at both ends carry it. Note: the configurator checks fit only, not load rating of the printed hangers.
Eight hex-acc-hook plates (each carries two hooks, so 16 hooks) spread across the three cells: accessory refs 0#-1,0#2/3/4/5, 0#0,0#1/2/4, 0#1,0#0.

requirements.requirement: Rack body / structure to carry the hangers and hooks
requirements.evidence: Three full bases piece:-1,0,0;full, piece:0,0,0;full, piece:1,0,0;full in one joined group, with lockJoints bolts (jointBolt:0#-1,0#0, 0#0,0#0) and capOpenFaces end cap applied. check_build ok, meshClash clear.

finish.summary: A 3-hex-wide wall tool rack: full bases at -1,0 / 0,0 / 1,0 form one locked, capped body. Keyhole hangers (hex-acc-keyhole) sit on the outer faces of the two end cells for lift-and-drop mounting on wall screws, and eight hook plates (hex-acc-hook, two hooks each = 16 hooks) are spread across all three cells for small hand tools. House rules applied (capOpenFaces, lockJoints); check_build passes with meshClash clear. Hanging demo props (cable coil / gaffer tape) were refused because the single-storey rack sits at bench height in the configurator and the props would hang through the bench — the hook accessories themselves accept those items, and on a real wall they hang freely.

lines.label: M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.

parts.use: Each plate carries two hooks side by side, so you bolt on as many as you want where you want them rather than committing a whole face to a rail.

parts.name: Keyhole hanger
parts.use: Hangs a cell on screws that are already in a wall, so mounting is a lift and a drop rather than a drilling job through the cluster.
